about: ENC check, the hazards for grounding (Coordinator 2, 21 Nov 2026): every rock (UWTROC), wreck (WRECKS) and obstruction (OBSTRN) in the race areas (37.79–37.90 N, 122.30–122.50 W), at any depth, from NOAA's harbor-scale (band 5) cells. id: the S-57 LNAM, unique. lat/lon: a point's position, or an area's or line's mean vertex (then 'outline' has its vertices, [lon, lat]). valsou_m: its least depth, m below MLLW (negative: dries that high); null where the ENC gives none (WATLEV, EXPSOU and QUASOU then say what's known: QUASOU 2, depth unknown, is to be taken as a danger). Sorted shoalest first, unknown depths last.
source: NOAA ENC cells, catalog ENCProdCat.xml of 2026-11-21 (scripts/fetch-charts.mjs); public domain, not for navigation
